chunks: When he saw a fire he said to his family: 'You wait here. I have seen a fire. I may haply be able to bring an ember from it, or find direction by the fire.'
ai.seo_question: What did the prophet say to his family when he saw a fire?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Taa-Haa, this verse describes Prophet Musa encountering a fire in the valley of Tuwa, where he instructs his family to remain stationary while he approaches to retrieve a 'qabas' (handful of coals) for warmth or to find guidance. Shia exegetes emphasize this dual purpose, viewing the fire not merely as a source of light but as the locus of divine revelation where Musa received the initial call to prophethood and the staff that would become a sign against Pharaoh.
